generation.scope: A generically finite reconstruction of the five-dimensional order-four half-period component uses two multipliers and a plane on a smooth intersection of two quadrics in projective five-space. Projection onto the plane reconstructs the two symmetric Schur blocks, while the two alternating pencils recover the remaining entries. The chart meets the regular Walsh locus. AS regularity at arbitrary closed points of this chart remains open.

open_mathematics: Prove an all-degree lifting criterion for unrestricted characteristic-zero adjacent-rank-six windows with regular reduction, and apply it on the fifteen-dimensional component.
